title: Flywheel Task Packet (DESIGN.md §5.1)
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of task-packet-<id>.md. The packet-id prefix encodes the milestone: M02-T03 belongs to milestone M-02.

packet-id.description: M<milestone>-T<task>, e.g. M02-T03. Milestone id is derived as M-02.

contract-version.description: Bumped by the Plan Loop whenever the packet is revised.

goal.description: One sentence: the observable outcome this unit must achieve.

requirements.description: Numbered requirement ids from spec.md (anti-omission mapping).

route.description: Execution route, resolved via the route table in flywheel.config.json (DESIGN.md §4.2).

needs-live-credentials.description: true = needs live credentials (kubeconfig/secrets); injected per unit only after human confirmation (DESIGN.md §9).

context-files.description: Files/anchors the executor must read, e.g. docs/spec.md#M-02.

cache-scope.description: Files placed in the stable prompt prefix (DESIGN.md §8).

boundaries.description: 防改做守卫。must-not-touch 或 max-files 至少声明一个——空 mapping 会静默关闭边界判定（审计 P2）。

must-not-touch.description: Path prefixes or exact paths that must not appear in the unit's git diff.

max-files.description: Maximum number of files the unit's diff may touch.

L1.description: Deterministic acceptance run directly by the orchestrator (build/lint/typecheck/unit tests/coverage gate).

L2.description: Integration tests, run at milestone gate.

L3.description: End-to-end scripts, run at milestone gate.

review-rubric.description: Review points and the pass line used by the Review Loop.

max-retries.description: Total attempts allowed before escalation (DESIGN.md §6 pseudocode: for attempt in range(max_retries)).

workflow-risks.description: Optional structured executor risk signal; nonempty risks upgrade Quick to Full before review.

done-report-format.description: Required shape of the executor's done-report (reports/<packet-id>.done.json).

script.description: Path to a script, for L3-style gates.
